question: Does qualified logical64 alignment improve full-request completion against both same-budget F and original X, retaining all costs and generation gaps?

modes.Y: same X resources/plan/copies; logical64 alignment followed by physical slot mapping, one kernel only

workload.selection: Eligible source articles97..112, after exact reconstruction1..96; no overlap with19 named B-line prior input files. Actual128-token prefixes only.

warmup.state: Default non-injection/non-same-engine first-request warmup, full completion before measurement; per-policy expert cache retained, no measurement reset. Warmup requests/KV drain; completed request KV is naturally freed, prefix caching disabled.
warmup.jit_scope: Original single request warmup follows explicit compile-domain preparation. Validate actual measurement compiler events; do not infer all-runtime warmness.
warmup.document_rule: First fixed document, 128->2; one per engine. Y applies logical alignment in original initialization/warmup/measurement paths, all costs retained.

experiment_unit: One new16-document cohort; six fresh engines ordered F/X/Y/Y/X/F. Two engines per arm and order remain confounded; not a noise floor or significance estimate.
primary: first planned arrival to final completion of all16 requests
secondary: arrival-based per-request TTFT and completion latency
actual expert+KV bytes and CUDA peak allocated/reserved
entire subprocess wall including initialization,warmup,capture,finalize,IO and shutdown
accounting: Capture excludes prior warmup/setup and following finalization/shutdown; full subprocess wall retains all.
No cycle_complete or runtime GC observer in reused single-capture branch; memory trace retention stays until finalize, with cost retained.
Do not sum nested host/CUDA/apply spans into wall. Include actual preemption/recomputation, failures and every cell; no subtraction of warmup/observer/IO costs.

Clock arrivals are submitted between synchronous engine steps. Arrival lag is distinct from native queue waiting; cohort capture includes the initial arrival transient and final drain, but excludes engine startup. This finite cohort is not steady-state.
boundaries: Same384 physical expert slots and1GiB KV in all arms; Y changes alignment indexing only, with its mapping/Python/compile costs retained.
All6 engines retained; report Y/F,Y/X,X/F in both blocks plus same-arm differences. No post-hoc canonical selection.
Original capture/compiler probe and pager trace stay active; no numerical/reference/prefix/negative or H CPU/GC observer in performance.
Finite arrival experiment at artificial expert budget on OLMoE; no true model-OOM deployment, task quality, SLO or EP claim.
One-cohort directional agreement is only an existence signal. Stronger independent validation required before stable benefit claims.
Respect all currently registered GPU groups, whole-group flock and per-engine live GPU check; no kill/waiter/retry.

compiler_domain.position: After original engine initialization, before the sole 128->2 request warmup
compiler_domain.domain: M1..160 x two BF16 GEMMs: F local/global64 mapNone; X local/global384 mapped; Y local384/global64 mapped False. Local physical geometry/config fixed within X/Y; alignment buffers/EM follow actual global domain.
compiler_domain.action: Compile-only warmup=True via original invoke helper and explicit CompiledKernel._init_handles; no expert/GPU kernel launch, pager ensure/LRU/KV or weight mutation.
compiler_domain.cache: Every fresh engine starts with its own empty private Triton disk cache. Other backend caches retain current environment and are not declared cold.
compiler_domain.coverage_rule: All source declared invocations complete; pager state unchanged; zero actual compiler_pipeline events during request measurement. Preserve any failure or miss as coverage failure, never delete or retry a cell.
compiler_domain.claim_boundary: Only this MoE Triton family compile/handles are covered, not all runtime paths. Monitor other compilers; full precompile/startup/memory cost retained. No subtraction or claim of full steady-state based on precompile alone.
compiler_domain.failure_policy: Stop after first completed cell whose coverage is false, keep its actual COMPLETE request status and all measurements; no automatic retry. Pending cells stay unrun.

decision_rule.primary: Capture observation_end_s is primary; cohort_last_completion corroborates. Do not switch to favorable secondary after results.
decision_rule.report: Report Y/F,Y/X,X/F direct ratios in forward and reverse; same-arm repeats and ratio of two-engine means. Show mean completion,maxITL,transfer and whole process costs even when adverse.
decision_rule.continue: Both Y/F and Y/X capture improvements in both ordered blocks, without repeated adverse maximum ITL, permit a second independent workload check. This is exploratory only, no arbitrary percent threshold or inferred noise bound.
decision_rule.stop_current_claim: Direction flip, consistent old-progress harm, or failure to beat strongest F keeps MEASUREMENT_ONLY; use observed costs for a precise boundary, no threshold scan or paging-family NO_GO.
decision_rule.qualification: Input/resource/path/call/compile coverage failure stops the group, keeps failed and pending cells; no replacement or retry.
decision_rule.observer: No reference/numeric/negative/prefix or H CPU/GC observers. Existing compiler probe and original call trace kept and fully costed.
